suggestions.title: Site page
suggestions.description: A standalone page about the studio itself, such as its home, story, approach, services, careers or contact details, that opens with a hero line and a call to action and then explains one part of the business to prospective clients or recruits.
suggestions.why: All six entries are top-level pages built the same way (hero, text, image, quote, cta), each with a short headline, a one-line intro and a button before plain-spoken sections about one part of Northfold.
